subject: depth
text: - Paint children and stacking contexts are built after layout and transforms; `StackingContext` and `HoistedPaintChild` are public re-exports (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:121-125; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:89)

subject: depth
text: - A node is a stacking-context root for opacity not equal to 1, fixed or sticky position, z-index on relative or absolute (or static flex/grid items), any transform/rotate/scale/translate, atomic paint effects, or `isolation: isolate` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1332-1375); atomic paint effects are opacity, filter, clip-path and mask-image (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1377-1406)

subject: depth
text: - Children paint in stacking order: negative z-index hoisted children, regular paint children, then positive z-index hoisted children (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:1106-1169); hit-testing walks positive-z hoisted children, then paint children in reverse, then negative-z hoisted children (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1568-1632), skipping a node dropped since the last resolve as the paint tree's walk does (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree), and since 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit it stops at the padding box of a node paint clips — by `overflow`, or by a computed `contain` that includes `paint` on a box paint applies it to (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — the root element excepted: a point outside that box reaches none of the node's hoisted children, paint children or inline content, as paint clips them, and the node itself is still answered inside its border box (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1534-1567; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep its answer at an element's own box is measured, in both layout modes and both builds — an `img` holding raster data answers the `img`, a block inside an `iframe`'s `srcdoc` sub-document answers the `iframe` (the parent's walk does not enter the sub-document, pinned as it reads) and a filled text `input` answers the `input` — and a box both transformed and scrolled is hit where its rows show, not through its scrolled-out content (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:431-584; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md)

subject: depth
text: - Positioned descendants with `z-index: auto` share one paint level per CSS 2.1 Appendix E and paint in tree order (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_order.rs:1-2)

subject: depth
text: - Outset box shadows are clipped when opacity is below 1 or the background is not opaque, and blurred shadows use the averaged border radius per a TODO (packages/blitz-paint/src/render/box_shadow.rs:15-24; packages/blitz-paint/src/render/box_shadow.rs:77-82); an outset shadow takes the element's shape corner for corner, so one with no blur and no spread hides behind the element, with expected pixels from Chromium (tests/blitz-tests/tests/outset_box_shadow_shape.rs:1-6)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Smooth scrolls run 300 ms on a cubic ease-in-out curve (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:112-122; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:432-433); `scroll-behavior: smooth` makes `Auto` scrolls animate and `auto` behavior jumps (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:528-545; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:264-293; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:374-383); a wheel event over a scroller cancels an in-progress smooth scroll (tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:356-372)

subject: expression-motion
text: - A programmatic into-view scroll never animates a nested scrolling box: `BaseDocument::scroll_into_view` writes every scrolling box that holds its target at once, innermost first, whatever behaviour was asked — the document holds one scroll animation at a time — and the requested behaviour, `Smooth` included, applies to the viewport alone; the driver's `scroll` is instant in every box and in the viewport, made inside one settled step (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:655-734; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/input.rs:235-245; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scroll_into_view_nested.rs:1-10; ratified by the founder, 2026-10-07 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-refusal-detection/report.md)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Touch flings decelerate per frame until velocity drops below 0.1 (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:867-885)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Overlay scrollbars show at full opacity on scroll, stay opaque for `FADE_DELAY` = 500 ms after last activity, then fade linearly over `FADE_DURATION` = 200 ms, documented as Chromium's overlay timings (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/scrollbar.rs:12-26; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1975-1992; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:725-730; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:752-755); finished fades are dropped each resolve (packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:67-74); hovering where a hidden thumb would be does not summon it, and the thumb changes appearance on hover and while dragged (tests/blitz-tests/tests/scrollbars.rs:1-4; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scrollbar_drag.rs:136-166; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scrollbar_drag.rs:168-222)

subject: expression-motion
text: - Right after a scroll the shown overlay scrollbar takes a main-button pointerdown in its band as a thumb drag (`hit_with_scrollbar` while `scrollbar_opacity > 0`) and dispatches nothing; on the virtual clock it stays shown until an `advance` passes its fade, and a pointer left on the thumb keeps it shown — so a driver `click` on a Cells cell in that band right after a `scroll` lands on the scrollbar, and an `advance` past the fade comes first (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:176-192; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:91-133; as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)

subject: expression-motion
text: - The shell's animation clock is seconds since the first animation-time query, and frames keep redrawing while the document is animating (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:281-289; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:438-440); the test harness drives animation from the `VirtualClock` its documents read — the overlay scrollbar fade, smooth scrolling and the fling read it headlessly — moved by `tick`, `advance_time` and the driver's `advance` (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs:152-174), and settle reads animation time only through that clock, never advancing it; the driver's `advance` moves that clock by exactly its `ms` and, through the step a session's caller hands it, the app's own time — on the stand whole Timer ticks — together (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18), while `click`, `type` and `press` leave it where it was: a driver click beside a running CSS animation returns settled without waiting on it (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_timer.rs:1-12; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_virtual_clock.rs:50-96 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-one-virtual-clock/report.md)

subject: desktop-native-tokens
text: - Every document gets the blitz `DEFAULT_CSS` user-agent stylesheet, once, through `DocumentConfig::default()` — `UserAgentStylesheet::default_sheet()` (packages/blitz-dom/src/config.rs:74-93) — since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship (upstream #1189), where until then `DioxusDocument::new` added it itself

subject: desktop-native-tokens
text: - In that sheet a `select` takes the border (`1px solid #999`), padding (`2px`) and background (`white`) of `input, textarea` and `display: inline-block`, and a single-choice select shows its chosen option alone (`select:not([multiple]) > option:checked { display: inline; }` beside `option { display: none; }`), so it lays out as a box holding its chosen option's label — engine defaults, no design token (packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:77-78; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:84-86; packages/blitz-dom/assets/default.css:155-159)
